item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra
item.description:
Astra is rolling out from limited organizational access to ChatGPT, Codex and API surfaces. OpenAI reports major gains in computer use, coding, science and cybersecurity; benchmark numbers remain vendor-reported until independently reproduced.

Source: OpenAI · Impact 98 · Buzz 99 · Utility 88
